Field.Label: The IP address or hostname of your UniFi OS console (UNVR/Dream Machine), e.g. 192.168.0.10.
secure="true" only masks this field in the Indigo UI - it does NOT store the key encrypted on disk. Treat Indigo's preferences file as containing this key in the clear.
Generate a key on your UniFi OS console: Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations -> Create API Key.
UniFi OS consoles serve a self-signed certificate by default. Leave unchecked unless you have installed your own trusted certificate.
